scope: resolved_calcium@5 / resolved_tissue@6 extend the shared HCN/NaV/Kv1.5/Kir2.1 catalog with pinned BETSE Kv1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4 and 1.6. Direct source capture checks all six Kv1 laws, gate powers and native update clocks. Four synthetic closed two-cell/four-patch/five-outside 2-ms coupled cases with fifteen populations, owned cytosol/ER, buffers, IP3, CaV1.2, PMCA and synthetic reversible NCX; one-way neutral assembly availability. Numerical composition qualification, not measured physiology or native full BETSE equivalence. Standalone tissue is covered at initial rates; full trajectories here exercise owned-calcium composition.
checks: Host planning checks all twelve arm/timestep grids and both independent-clock and heterogeneous-law batches before trajectories. Two-world aggregate padded-work allowance is 2048; single-world allowance is 1024. Trace and aggregate batch working-storage allowances are 2 GiB each. The obsolete 200-step calcium budget must reject. Resource allowances do not alter numerical or physical tolerances.

Explicit resolved_calcium@5 identity with nested resolved_tissue@6; complete Kv1 catalog with one m/h gate pair per population and species/population transfer and heat ledgers. Older catalogs keep their restricted source laws, layouts and checkpoint identity. Complete old HCN/calcium initial states, rates and fields reduce bitwise.

Internal free calcium binding, calcium/ER transfer and sodium/ER transfer alter their HCN routes without charging plasma capacitors or duplicating ionic ownership. Blocking a shared population stops Na/K/Ca together while intrinsic gates continue. Absent chloride routes, charge-neutral species-ledger corruption and decreasing per-route heat must reject.

Batched worlds change an HCN law, a transported-species/law pair, and a new Kv1 inactivation power. Each world retains its own parameters and matches its standalone complete history bitwise. Checkpoint continuation rejects changed HCN, species/law and Kv1 gate-power identity. These are numerical routing controls, not independent biological cases.

Execute unchanged pinned BETSE 1.5.0 Kv1.1–Kv1.6 over 61 voltages from -120 to +60 mV and compare source hashes, initialization, targets, seconds-converted time constants, K permeability and gate powers. Three native semi-implicit clocks each retain 32 voltage-changing updates. Independent 80-digit Decimal equations and JIT CPU/GPU gates must agree. Continuous 3-ms clamps use analytic exponentials and three RK4 steps; finite activation/inactivation gradients and opening powers are checked separately. This does not identify the native clock with coupled RK4.

CPU independent references are reused on GPU only after checking passed status, exact serialized inputs and exact reference settings. New HCN/calcium references use rtol 1e-13, state atol 1e-16 and charge atol 5e-32 C; earlier calcium families retain their defaults. Baseline/release controls require stability under another fourfold tolerance tightening within 3e-14 per non-charge state and 3e-28 C, below the unchanged refinement floor.

Reference logarithmic means checked against 90-digit Decimal arithmetic; the previous calcium family's four small-initial-probe cases remain numerical reference regressions, separate from the new composition cases.

Independent full-node field roots and scalar/Decimal ion, ER, PMCA/NCX and Cav rates on compact/padded states and evolved stages; independently differentiated whole-system free energy

Local/global external transport, intracellular chemical reaction/ER ledgers, conserved ionic and nonionic moieties, charge increments and three maintained ATP-source work identities

Four complete thirty-four-field trajectories against segmented adaptive DOP853; blocked/released flux histories retain evolving intrinsic gates. Store-only, plasma-only and calcium-channel-only events remain accepted observation boundaries while unsupported off-grid observations and oversized sodium steps reject.

Intrinsic CaV gates continue under channel block. These are numerical controls, not additional biological cases.
Every state-field corruption rejected; actual invalid held controls, invalid RK4 trials and unconverged field solves refuse advancement; no clipping or hidden repair

Three timesteps (2.5/1.25/0.625 us) for both baseline and release; unchanged physical error budgets. Exact disk/fresh-process/terminal continuation; future transport branches preserve state and evolving gates; changed integration windows.

Two neutral cell-owned assembly pools control every NaV/all six Kv1/Kir/HCN population belonging to the cell, including all three HCN ion routes through one availability. Initial owner-control rates are checked independently; independently reconstructed random event histories drive segmented electrical/chemical references.

Exact complete assembly restart, changed windows and world partition; IP3 perturbation changes calcium without changing one-way assembly random events; owned ligand, calcium and patch readouts survive aggregation. Initial and evolved reports are checked directly against cell-owned state; missing ligand or calcium sections must be rejected
One versus sixteen GPU planning preserves world definitions and identity; no remote execution claim
Complete CPU/L4 state and readout comparisons, with separate charge/current/voltage tolerances and exact discrete event state; shared schema and checkpoint regressions
GPU busy and measured SM-active, per-counter coverage, allocated phase time, resource bounds, frozen sources and durable failure/completion receipts

Assembly reports and aggregation retain explicit world/species/channel axes, ordered species IDs, route weights and all active channel transfers. Missing or changed route metadata and malformed tensor shapes reject; padding is excluded. Evolved report values are reconstructed directly from complete state.

Each refinement timestep preserves exact inputs, observed/reference arrays, signed per-field errors and settings before assertions; failures remain failed. These numerical controls do not add independent biological cases.

Fresh serial process groups bound compilation memory; registered tests execute exactly once per backend. Duplicated fixtures preserve their original evidence and are not extra cases. Automatic follow-up is disabled.
scope_exclusions: Finite closed exterior only. Held-bath calcium input needs an independently bounded nonconserved chemical inventory and is deferred; standalone resolved_tissue models retain their separate reservoir capabilities.
Synthetic manufactured charge backgrounds and concentrations, including exterior Ca=0.02 mM for bounded conserved-pool verification; no measured tissue dataset or biological calibration
Pinned process equations are reused; this does not establish native full BETSE tissue trajectory or screened/finite-difference field equivalence
Maintained ATP/ADP/Pi sources, not a finite metabolic reaction network; synthetic NCX and buffer kinetics
Assembly is a one-way neutral-protein channel-availability hypothesis. No biochemical feedback into assembly, protein energy, or experimentally established calcium/assembly link
Accepted-grid observations only. No interpolation guarantee, moving boundaries, water flow, deformation or growth
Dense resolved electrical closure and up to sixteen owned cells per world. Sixteen-GPU readiness concerns independent worlds; no multi-GPU execution or distributed single tissue is qualified here
GPU counters include compilation and host correctness work. No single warmed interval or utilization/throughput target is claimed

Old resolved_calcium@1/@2 catalogs remain restricted to potassium; resolved_calcium@3 retains the earlier single-ion sodium/potassium catalog. Numerical controls, refinement, old-model reductions and replay are not independent biological cases. The two-task/channel-compensation research remains parked. The earlier shared HCN catalog remains fixed as resolved_tissue@5 / resolved_calcium@4.

Kv1 catalog composition is new numerical evidence, not measured tissue physiology, a calibrated action potential, cAMP signaling or longer-time validation. Gates are restricted to the inherited -120 to +60 mV domain at 298.15 K. Assembly remains a one-way hypothesis with neutral protein pools and no protein energy/metabolic feedback.
